about: Practical Lisbon this week (work/17): cafés, coworking spaces and community venues near the week's events, each read on the venue's own public page at read_at (UTC; Lisbon is on UTC in November). 'open_today' is on | closed | unknown; 'unknown' means no public page says so for the storm days. Stated hours are what the venue publishes, not a promise it is open. No contact details, no private people.
independence: Lisbon Fringe is independent of Web Summit and is not run by its organisers. Not a warning service: for the storm see IPMA (https://www.ipma.pt), ANEPC (https://www.prociv.gov.pt) and https://storm-charles.promptugal.news.

storm.about: City-wide closures are the storm site's data. Read them there; they are not copied here.

fields: id, name, kind, area, address, url (the venue's own page), read_at, hours (as stated), open_today (on | closed | unknown), label (fact | evidence | hypothesis), storm_note, events (ids in data/events.json held there this week), note
